correctness.rationale: Exact independent-side integration yields \(M_2=L^2(1-3h)/24\) and \(M_4=L^4(3-45h+20hp)/720\). Heron gives h=xyz>0 and elementary symmetric identities give p and q, so Vieta recovers the unordered side lengths. Sharp \(Q\in[8/5,12/5)\) follows from AM–GM and an explicitly decreasing scalar polynomial; the right endpoint occurs only in a degenerate limit. At fixed L and h, a constrained quadratic symmetric objective has two distinct isosceles extrema, with a strict ordering from the cubic-root sum; a connected level curve yields every value between them. All hypotheses and equality cases are stated, and exact computational identities plus independent sampling were executed as supplementary checks.

value.rationale: A natural inverse geometric statistic: a single even moment loses a shape parameter, but two even moments plus perimeter reconstruct every nondegenerate triangle exactly and constructively. Sharp dimensionless concentration bounds and complete isosceles extrema under fixed perimeter/area quantify its geometric range; genuine continuous families and equality classifications are proved rather than tabulated.
